title: hunkboard diff.json
description: One review round. Written only by the publisher (hunkboard-publish). Contains the raw unified diff plus full old/new contents of changed text files so the viewer can expand context, show whole files and recompute whitespace-insensitive diffs offline.

repo.description: Display name of the repository (namespace segment 1).

branch.description: Branch or ref name under review (namespace segment 2).

base.description: The revision the working tree was diffed against, e.g. HEAD or a commit hash.

round.description: Monotonic round counter within this repo/branch namespace, if the publisher keeps history.

generator.description: Tool and version that produced this file, e.g. hunkboard-publish/0.1.0.

rawDiff.description: Verbatim output of git diff (unified format, rename detection on). May be empty when nothing changed.

files.description: Full contents keyed by path as it appears in rawDiff (new path for renames). Only changed text files within the size limit are included.

old.description: Content at base. null when the file did not exist (added) or was omitted.

new.description: Content in the working tree. null when deleted or omitted.

truncated.description: true when contents were omitted because the file exceeded the publisher's size limit.
